summary: Interacting with certain villagers with the villager trade rebalance enabled causes client crash
description: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, if that villager s career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items (e.g. plains armorer), then the game will crash. To reproduce: - Create a new world. Make sure the villager trade rebalance is enabled. - Level an armorer up to either expert (does not apply to expert level taiga villagers) or master level. - Save and quit the world. - Reopen the world. - Interact with the armorer. - The game will crash. I ve also attached both a crash report from a vanilla client and one that is deobfuscated with the official mappings.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world.
2. Ensure that the villager trade rebalance feature is enabled.
3. Level an armorer villager to either expert or master level.
4. Save and quit the world.
5. Reopen the world.
6. Interact with the armorer villager.
7. Observe that the game crashes upon interaction.
Observed Behavior: When interacting with certain villagers with the villager trade rebalance enabled, the game will crash if the villager's career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items, such as those found on plains armorer villagers. To reproduce this issue, create a new world and ensure the villager trade rebalance is enabled. Level an armorer up to either expert (excluding expert-level taiga villagers) or master level, save and quit the world, then reopen it. Interacting with the armorer at these levels will cause the game to crash. This behavior has been documented with both a vanilla client crash report and a deobfuscated version using official mappings for further analysis by developers.
Expected Behavior: When interacting with a villager whose career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items (e.g., plains armorer) with the villager trade rebalance enabled, the game should not crash. The player should be able to open the trading interface and browse available trades without any issues. This behavior should be consistent regardless of the villager's level or the type of trades offered.
